prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: an actual square 2048x2048 videogame UV ALBEDO SKIN, for the REGULAR-CAB PICKUP.
Input 1 is the EXACT UV REGISTRATION TEMPLATE to repaint. Input 2 is the approved 2D design sheet; use ONLY vehicle A as the painting/style reference.
Keep the first image's complete composition, scale, pixel registration, feature shapes, and orientation EXACTLY. Do not redraw a truck illustration. This is a flat unwrapped texture, not a picture of a car. No perspective, body silhouette, wheels, shadows on a ground plane, labels, or text. Do not rearrange anything.
Layout to preserve: top strip = single SIDE skin with one cab side window towards the RIGHT and two wheel-arch guide curves near its lower edge; middle region = long TOP skin with nine bed-floor ribs at the LEFT and the narrow tall trapezoid WINDSCREEN at the RIGHT; bottom-left = FRONT face with two square headlights, central grille, lower bumper; bottom-right = REAR face with the wide cab-back window ABOVE the tailgate, two vertical red tail lamps, and lower bumper.
Paint a rich, restrained 2D gouache/oil albedo finish matching the craft and material detail of approved pickup A. Enamel must be LIGHT NEUTRAL warm gray/ivory, not green: the game adds the sage/oxide/teal finish, so the base coat must remain neutral. Preserve blue-gray GLASS, charcoal RUBBER, dull warm gray steel, cream headlamp lenses, amber indicators and muted red rear lamp lenses.
Replace the simple flat template fills with intentional brushwork following each panel. Paint subtle raised fender crowns along the existing wheel arch curves, door recess shadows and narrow worn light-catching edges along the EXACT existing shut lines, gentle bonnet and roof plane highlights, rubbed bed rails, scratched and dusty bed-floor ribs, small varied chipped paint and rusty ochre nicks concentrated at the sills, wheel arches, tailgate and cargo bed. The main panels remain broad quiet readable painted enamel, never camouflage or random noisy diagonal texture. Glass has soft irregular painted sky/cloud reflections with a dark interior, not giant crossed brush stripes. Grille recess and mesh/slats, lamp lens ribs, tailgate handle, door handle, black window gaskets and bumper scuffing are painted surface art. Keep every feature in the exact location shown in input 1, and preserve all neutral blank surface coverage between features so the skin is usable on connected 3D surfaces.
Even diffuse lighting; painted material shading only, no cast lighting or photo-real gloss. Exact square canvas, no frame, no borders or gutters added. This is production UV texture painting; strict registration is more important than adding details.
